name: Impromptu
prompts: Did the speech tie back to the topic?
Were the examples a good fit?

tags.label: Link to the topic
tags.strength: You tied the speech back to your topic all the way through.
tags.toWork: Tie each point back to the topic you drew.

tags.label: Structure
tags.strength: Your speech was easy to follow from point to point.
tags.toWork: Make each part of the speech easier to follow, with clear steps.

tags.label: Examples
tags.strength: Your examples fit the topic well.
tags.toWork: Use one or two clear examples to support each point.

tags.label: Poise
tags.strength: You stayed calm and sure of yourself.
tags.toWork: Take a breath and stay steady when you lose your place.

source: NSDA High School Unified Manual v2027.1.2, 2026-27 season. Summarized in our own words; no rule text copied.
